name: spotlight-button
title: Spotlight button
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A host button with a cursor spotlight and a border that lights up near the pointer.

meta.descriptionEs: Un botón del host con un foco que sigue al cursor y un borde que se enciende cerca del puntero.

examples.title: Botón con foco
examples.description: Un botón del host con un foco que sigue al cursor y un borde que se enciende cerca del puntero.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: 320px, texto largo, y lectura de derecha a izquierda.

api.name: highlightColor / borderColor
api.description: CSS colors. Defaults mix the host foreground and background.

docs: Adapted from Evil Buttons highlight-button (Apache-2.0, radiumcoders, commit ec0fa86f8d06). The ripple is skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion. See NOTICE. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
